newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Strong tone to cash markets and South Korea announced results of beef tender.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Higher corn futures should offset advance in CME feeder index.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Steady to lower cash hog calls as packer cut kills but Japan said they would exempt some pork imports from tariffs during August.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Reduced kills supportive but futures need to invert and move under fresh.
